description.value: Peak Cellars is an award-winning, cool-climate winery in Lake Country's Okanagan Valley, producing estate-grown wines recognized internationally — including a Gold Medal Chardonnay at the 2025 Chardonnay du Monde. The property includes a Garden Bistro serving farm-to-table seasonal dishes sourced from an on-site garden, a tasting room with guided premium seated tastings overlooking the vineyard and lake, and on-site accommodations. It is a full-destination stop on the Okanagan wine trail, offering a relaxed, scenic environment well suited to cycling visitors.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content was successfully fetched and is rich with detail about an award-winning winery, Garden Bistro, tasting room, and accommodations in Lake Country. Phone number on the website header (250-766-9922) matches OSM. The website consistently brands as 'Peak Cellars' rather than 'O'Rourke's Peak Cellars', though 'O'Rourke Family Estate' appears in the job fair blurb, suggesting the OSM name reflects the parent estate. Takeout and vegetarian/vegan/GF options are explicitly confirmed by the bistro menu; bike-specific amenities are not mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: Website uses 'Peak Cellars' as the primary brand throughout; OSM name 'O'Rourke's Peak Cellars' reflects the parent O'Rourke Family Estate but is not the displayed brand name on the website. May confuse cyclists searching by name.
No bike parking or bike rack mentioned anywhere on the website — this required criterion could not be confirmed and should be verified on-site or by contacting the business.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A full-service destination winery with a farm-to-table bistro, tasting room, and accommodations on the Okanagan wine route in Lake Country — a natural and high-value stop for touring cyclists, pending confirmation of bike parking.
